request: Add a linear decay function to the challenge scoring code: value drops per solve, floored at minimum.

summary.result_text:
I added `linear(challenge)` to `CTFd/plugins/challenges/decay.py`. It wasn't run or tested. My syntax check was blocked pending approval, so I never ran it.

The value drops by `challenge.decay` points per solve, starting from `challenge.initial`, and is rounded up and floored at `challenge.minimum`. The first solver still gets the full initial value. Hidden and banned solvers are excluded from the count, the same way `logarithmic` does it.

`DECAY_FUNCTIONS` in that file already listed `"linear": linear`, but `linear` was never defined. Importing the module would have raised a `NameError`, and this fixes that. The function is a copy of the one in `CTFd/plugins/dynamic_challenges/decay.py`.
